newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CSR expects better full year profit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CSR expects better full year profit.

text.p: Building materials, sugar and aluminium group CSR Ltd said on Monday it expected an improvement in profit for the year to March 31, 1998.
It said results from the first quarter supported this expectation of stronger full year profits.

"We expect to enjoy steady market conditions and attractive margins in most of our American businesses," he said.
"Overall, we expect an improvement in profit last year," Coates .
"The first quarter's results support this expectation."
CSR's annual net profit fell 36 percent to A$212.2 million in 1996/97.
CSR's shares fell seven cents to close at A$5.27 on Friday.
CSR Managing Director Geoffrey Kells said in May the outlook for the year ahead was more favourable than the year just completed.
Analysts expectations for calendar 1998 profit are grouped around A$287 million.
